The case holds no component value. Its dimensions at their tolerance corners are stack-ups, which are class 13 (VER-20, VER-174, VER-181).
The case has no electrical state to sequence. The reset and boot pinholes through it belong to the mcu's reset (VER-107).
The case has no schematic and no copper. Where the board's parts sit against the case is class 13 (VER-19, VER-174).
The case has no footprint or land pattern: it is printed, not assembled by JLC. Its openings against the parts are classes 13 and 14.
Class 10 is the PCB's fab rules at JLC (holes, plating, clearances, silk). The case is printed by Alex; whether a print makes the parts that fit is VER-48 (class 13).
No case part is on JLC's BOM or CPL. The case is printed, and its hand parts (screws, silicone, caps, domes) are bom.md's, which VER-167 and VER-147 check.
The case carries no signal: there is no radio, antenna or cable through it. Static through its seams is class 7 (VER-95, VER-170).

The cell's subsystem carries DC only: VBAT_SENSE is read at DC through C8 (100 nF) and TH1's TS node is a DC level. No clock or data passes through it.
